title: Grade 5 4.01
description: Learning Outcomes for Grade 5: Identify simple fractions | Read and identify fractions | Identify numerator and denominator | Interpret fractions | Recognise proper fractions | Identify fractions from descriptions | Understand denominator meaning | Understand numerator meaning | Represent fractions correctly | Identify proper fractions | Recognise common fractions | Apply fractions to real-world situations | Represent real-world situations as fractions

questions.question: Which fraction represents one part out of two equal parts?
questions.solution: Use the key clue in the question and apply the lesson method step by step. This leads to 1/2; 1/3; 1/4.

questions.question: Which fraction represents one part out of four equal parts?
questions.solution: Use the key clue in the question and apply the lesson method step by step. This leads to 1/4; 1/2; 1/3.

questions.question: Which fraction is read as "one third"?
questions.solution: Use the key clue in the question and apply the lesson method step by step. This leads to 1/3; 3/1; 1/4.

questions.question: Which fraction is read as "one fifth"?
questions.solution: Use the key clue in the question and apply the lesson method step by step. This leads to 1/5; 5/1; 1/4.

questions.question: What is the numerator in 3/8?
questions.solution: Compute the operation: 3 / 8 = 0.375.

questions.question: What is the denominator in 3/8?
questions.solution: Compute the operation: 3 / 8 = 0.375.

questions.question: In 5/7, what does the denominator tell us?

questions.question: In 5/7, what does the numerator tell us?
options: Selected parts; Total parts; Number of wholes
questions.solution: Compute the operation: 5 / 7 = 0.7142857142857143.
